text: Business Administration is a comprehensive discipline that studies the operational laws of enterprises, organizational management logic, and business decision-making methods. Its core is to cultivate business talents who are "proficient in operation, skilled in management, and capable of making decisions". It is based on economics and management, integrating knowledge from multiple disciplines such as psychology, law, and sociology, and covers the entire process of enterprise management from establishment to development, from strategy to implementation. From the management of a small start-up company to the global strategic layout of a multinational group, all fall within its research and application scope.
